summary: The player charges and fires several shots, missing two at first before landing a level-2 charged shot that destroys an enemy, and then another level-1 charged shot that disarms a small enemy.

events.evidence: White projectile flies upward after cannon indicator resets from 1 bar; firing sound heard.
Projectile travels off the top of the playfield without hitting any enemies.
Player ship moves left toward the center of the lane.
Cannon HUD shows 2 bars before releasing a large glowing projectile; blast sound heard.
Large projectile impacts the leftmost enemy in the upper row; impact sound and flash.
Enemy hit by the charged shot bursts into an expanding white ring and disappears; score increases from 369 to 513.
Player ship moves right across the lane.
Cannon HUD has 1 cyan bar and releases a white bolt upward; firing sound heard.
Bolt strikes the rightmost enemy in the middle group; crisp metallic hit sound.
Target reticle shows 'DISARM', a small part flies off, and the left-side log states 'Lane Control logs a disarm'; enemy ship remains intact and drifts downward.
Player releases another 1-bar charged shot at the end of the clip.

readability_issues.issue: Enemy pink bullets pass directly over pink-outlined enemy ships, making the bullets blend in with the enemy outlines.
Bright bloom from the player's ship and level-2 charged shot release temporarily obscures nearby enemy ships.
The disarmed enemy ship retains a glowing pink ring similar to active enemies and bullets, floating close to the player and creating visual clutter.
